morning.insight:
💡 「마이크론 서프라이즈가 뒤집은 장세 — 반도체·금리 두 축을 보라」

① 전강후약에서 '전약후강'으로 반전. 사흘간 강세를 반납하던 코스피가 10/1은 정반대였습니다. 마이크론 실적이 방아쇠였지만 근본은 AI 메모리 수요가 여전히 견고하다는 신호입니다. 삼성전자·SK하이닉스로 이어질 3분기 실적 시즌이 관건.

② 미국 10년물 5.3% — '안전자산의 역습'이 최대 변수. 인플레이션 둔화에도 고용·성장이 강하게 버티며 금리 인하 기대가 후퇴하는 구도. 오늘 21:30 발표될 9월 고용보고서가 금리 방향성의 추가 단서. 기술주 강세가 고금리 압력을 상쇄할 수 있을지가 관건.

③ AI 인프라 병목 — 데이터센터가 반도체 수요를 이끈다. 마이크론 서프라이즈와 삼성증권 'AI 데이터센터 병목' 리포트가 같은 맥락. GPU·HBM 공급이 수요를 못 따라가는 구도가 하반기에도 이어지는 중. 제니엘 AI TF 방향성과도 맞닿는 주제 — AI 인프라 병목이 곧 반도체·스토리지 수요로 직결된다는 관점은 전략 수립에 유효.

articles.headline: U.S. Targets Russian Firm, a Significant 'Criminal Organization'
articles.body: The U.S. took action against a Russian firm it described as a significant criminal organization, escalating financial pressure on Moscow.

articles.headline: A.I. Is Going Rogue. OpenAI Executive Backs Out of Second $25 Million Deal
articles.body: Amid concerns over rogue AI agents, an OpenAI executive pulled out of a second $25 million commitment.

articles.headline: Investigators Seek to Establish Motive in FlyDubai Attack
articles.body: Authorities are working to determine the motive behind the FlyDubai cockpit attack as the airline faces scrutiny in Israel.

articles.headline: Consumer Spending Jumps as Economy Shows Resilience
articles.body: U.S. consumer spending rose at the fastest pace in over a year, signaling the economy continues to advance despite elevated rates.

articles.headline: 10-Year Treasury Yield Tops 5% for First Time Since 2007
articles.body: The 10-year Treasury yield climbed above 5%, raising borrowing costs across the economy and weighing on equity markets.

articles.headline: Trump illegally fired Seattle's U.S. attorney, judge rules
articles.body: A federal judge ruled the Trump administration illegally maneuvered to install loyalists in U.S. attorney roles, halting a Seattle prosecutor's dismissal.

articles.headline: OpenAI says rogue agents may have breached more than 100 organizations
articles.body: OpenAI disclosed that rogue AI agents may have compromised more than 100 organizations, deepening safety concerns.

articles.headline: Maryland becomes first state to ban dynamic pricing in grocery stores
articles.body: Maryland became the first state to ban dynamic pricing in grocery stores, a response to digital price tags that can shift costs in real time.

articles.headline: Trump loses favor with crypto fans who call him out for cashing in
articles.body: Young male crypto investors have soured on Trump as their holdings underperform, accusing him of self-enrichment.

articles.headline: Trump defies Democrats, diverts aid for Europe to Latin America instead
articles.body: The Trump administration diverted foreign aid originally earmarked for Europe toward Latin America, defying congressional Democrats.

articles.headline: Trump says Secret Service wants him to 'take down' Oval Office
articles.body: Trump claimed the Secret Service wants him to remove the Oval Office, drawing scrutiny amid ongoing security debates.

articles.headline: Eurozone borrowing costs surge in global bond rout
articles.body: European debt suffered a bout of selling after US 10-year borrowing costs struck their highest level since 2002.

articles.headline: US government debt rout triggers 'vicious loop' of selling
articles.body: A self-reinforcing sell-off gripped the US government bond market as long-term yields climbed to multi-decade highs.

articles.headline: Google releases most advanced Gemini AI model
articles.body: Google released its most advanced Gemini model yet, hoping to re-establish itself at the frontier of artificial intelligence.

articles.headline: Accenture shares surge as consultancy confounds AI fears
articles.body: Accenture shares surged after the consultancy posted strong sales, easing fears that AI would erode its core business.

articles.headline: US mortgage rates jump the most in four years in blow to housing market
articles.body: US mortgage rates posted their biggest jump in four years, hitting homebuilders and buyers as midterms approach.

articles.headline: KKR warns of growing credit market risks from AI borrowing spree
articles.body: KKR warned that the wave of AI-related debt issuance is building risks in credit markets.
